The following are suggested Primary Skills for this
A hero can attempt to carry more of the burden of supplies or to take on more than his or her share of the scouting and hunting duties in order to allow his or her allies to preserve their strength.
A hero can attempt to use his or her knowledge of terrain formations to find easier paths, reducing the chances of running into danger during the trek.
A hero can attempt to use common survival techniques to bolster his or her allies' energy reserves and find adequate food, water, and shelter during the trek.
Each time a hero earns a Failure (whether or not that Failure is later removed), the heroes are delayed in their trek by one day.
